prompt: As of January 1st, 2024, how many buildings in New York City were 750ft or taller the last time Halley's Comet came close to Earth?
answer:
Halley’s Comet last made a close approach to Earth on **April 11, 1986**. At that time, **13 New York City buildings were 750 feet (about 229 meters) or taller**.

They were:

- Empire State Building
- Chrysler Building
- 40 Wall Street
- 70 Pine Street
- Woolworth Building
- 30 Rockefeller Plaza
- 28 Liberty Street
- MetLife Building
- Citicorp Center (now 601 Lexington Avenue)
- 1251 Avenue of the Americas
- One Penn Plaza
- One World Trade Center
- Two World Trade Center

This uses the buildings’ commonly reported architectural heights and counts the Twin Towers separately.
